candidates.name: Penal-fiscal intent architecture
candidates.hypothesis: Strengthening the existing fiscal practice page and adding only genuinely distinct high-intent subtopics can capture specialized demand without duplicating the current page.

candidates.name: Penal-fiscal search campaign
candidates.hypothesis: A separately measured Google Ads campaign for penal-fiscal intent may acquire more qualified demand than generic penal terms.

candidates.name: SAT event-response pathways
candidates.hypothesis: Distinct educational pathways for invitation, requirement, audit and fiscal citation events can intercept demand earlier than a generic tax-crime page.

candidates.name: Penal-fiscal proof and case authority
candidates.hypothesis: A rigorously sourced proof layer combining trajectory, documented experience and publishable fiscal-case evidence can improve trust for high-stakes fiscal-criminal matters.

candidates.name: Interactive fiscal calendar
candidates.hypothesis: A web-native fiscal calendar with filtering, reminders and official-source links can create repeated pre-crisis contact with business owners and accountants.

candidates.name: Fiscal-to-penal risk navigator
candidates.hypothesis: An interactive educational navigator can distinguish ordinary compliance events from escalation signals and route only appropriate users to criminal counsel.

candidates.name: Deadline and requirement alert subscription
candidates.hypothesis: Permission-based alerts tied to official fiscal dates and authority-event checklists can create recurring branded utility before legal urgency arises.

candidates.name: Accountant and business-owner bridge
candidates.hypothesis: Educational resources designed for accountants and business owners can create referral and early-warning pathways into CANO's fiscal-criminal practice.

candidates.name: Citatorio intent system
candidates.hypothesis: A dedicated citatorio journey across landing content, search ads and structured intake can outperform generic penal messaging for that situation.

candidates.name: Detention emergency system
candidates.hypothesis: A detention-specific journey emphasizing immediate response and frictionless contact can improve qualified emergency intake.

candidates.name: Initial-hearing system
candidates.hypothesis: An audiencia-inicial pathway can capture defendants/families seeking representation at a discrete high-intent procedural moment.

candidates.name: Intent-separated penal Ads routing
candidates.hypothesis: Separating citatorio, detenido, audiencia and other penal intents with matching negatives and destinations may reduce generic/authority-confused traffic.

candidates.name: Authority-insider positioning system
candidates.hypothesis: Making the documented authority-insider experience the organizing idea across high-intent journeys can differentiate CANO from generic criminal-defense messaging.

candidates.name: Verifiable trajectory timeline
candidates.hypothesis: A source-backed timeline of public-service and litigation milestones can increase trust without relying on generic superlatives.

candidates.name: Verified case-pattern library
candidates.hypothesis: A privacy-safe library of publishable case patterns can demonstrate applied expertise better than unsupported claims of success.

candidates.name: Technical authority publishing
candidates.hypothesis: Recurring expert explainers on criminal procedure and fiscal-criminal escalation can build topical authority around Cano's documented experience.

candidates.name: Corporate criminal defense pathway
candidates.hypothesis: A dedicated executive/company pathway can better match the needs of owners and legal representatives than general retail criminal copy.

candidates.name: Fraud and patrimonial executive pathway
candidates.hypothesis: Positioning complex fraud/patrimonial matters for owners and executives can create a higher-trust alternative to generic fraud pages.

candidates.name: Legal representative and accountant exposure hub
candidates.hypothesis: Content focused on legal representatives and accountants facing fiscal-criminal exposure can occupy a narrow professional-intent intersection.

candidates.name: Confidential executive intake
candidates.hypothesis: A privacy-forward intake path with clear diagnostic scope may reduce friction for high-stakes business/fiscal matters.

candidates.name: Local profile eligibility and evidence audit
candidates.hypothesis: Resolving office-eligibility and identity evidence before aggressive local SEO can prevent building a local strategy on an invalid premise.

candidates.name: Diagnostic-offer clarity
candidates.hypothesis: Clarifying exactly what the MXN 2,500 diagnostic includes and does not include can reduce price expectation mismatch and improve qualified consultations.

candidates.name: Structured WhatsApp triage
candidates.hypothesis: A situation-aware WhatsApp intake can preserve urgency while collecting enough non-sensitive context to route leads efficiently.

candidates.name: Ethical reputation evidence program
candidates.hypothesis: A compliant process for requesting and organizing genuine reviews and professional evidence can improve trust without fabricated social proof.
